snippet.title: Another Black Hole Incremental — Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
You begin as a speck. A hunger in the dark.
Another Black Hole Incremental is a roguelike incremental where you ARE the
black hole: eat, die, spend, and climb from cosmic dust to the center of a
galaxy. Every death makes you permanently stronger.

Play the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4989910?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer_01
Wishlist the full game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4969630?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer_01
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/Gbhs2m2xCf
